blocks.zh: Learning Objectives / 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 瞭解 WFI（注射用水）作為最高等級製藥用水的定義、用途與法規要求
blocks.en: Understand the definition, uses and regulatory requirements of WFI (Water for Injection), the highest grade of pharmaceutical water

blocks.zh: 掌握三種蒸餾技術：Single Effect (SE)、Multi-Effect (ME)、Vapor Compression (VC) 的原理與差異
blocks.en: Master the principles and differences of the three distillation technologies: Single Effect (SE), Multi-Effect (ME) and Vapor Compression (VC)

blocks.zh: 理解各蒸餾方式的產能範圍、前處理需求、材質選擇與經濟考量
blocks.en: Understand the capacity range, pretreatment needs, materials of construction and economics of each distillation method

blocks.zh: 認識 Reverse Osmosis (RO) 作為 WFI 生產手段的技術特點、優缺點與法規接受度
blocks.en: Understand the technical characteristics, advantages, disadvantages and regulatory acceptance of Reverse Osmosis (RO) as a means of producing WFI

blocks.zh: 能運用 WFI Systems Comparison 表（Table 6-4）比較不同方案，做出符合 GEP 的選型決策
blocks.en: Use the WFI Systems Comparison table (Table 6-4) to compare options and make GEP-compliant selection decisions

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 與 EP 對 WFI 製程方法的歷史差異及 2017 年 EP 修訂的重要意義
blocks.en: Understand the historical differences between USP and EP in WFI production methods, and the significance of the 2017 EP revision

blocks.zh: Section Navigation / 章節導覽
blocks.en: Section Navigation

blocks.zh: Commentary / 教學解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 導論重點
blocks.en: Key Points of the Introduction

blocks.zh: WFI 的地位
blocks.en: The Status of WFI

blocks.zh: WFI（Water for Injection，注射用水）是 USP 規範中最高等級的製藥用水。用途包括：
blocks.en: WFI (Water for Injection) is the highest grade of pharmaceutical water in the USP. Its uses include:

blocks.zh: 注射劑（Parenteral）製造
blocks.en: Manufacture of parenteral products

blocks.zh: 部分眼科產品與吸入劑
blocks.en: Certain ophthalmic and inhalation products

blocks.zh: 注射級原料藥（API）的最終步驟
blocks.en: The final steps of injectable-grade active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs)

blocks.zh: 簡言之：任何會直接進入人體血液或繞過人體天然防線的產品，都需要使用 WFI。
blocks.en: In short, any product that goes directly into the bloodstream or bypasses the body's natural defenses requires WFI.

blocks.zh: 比喻：水的等級制度
blocks.en: Analogy: A Hierarchy of Water

blocks.zh: 如果把製藥用水比喻成醫院的空間等級：
blocks.en: Think of pharmaceutical waters as the zones of a hospital:

blocks.zh: 飲用水 = 醫院大廳（一般公共區域）
blocks.en: Potable water = the hospital lobby (general public area)

blocks.zh: Purified Water = 一般病房（有基本管控）
blocks.en: Purified Water = an ordinary ward (basic controls)

blocks.zh: WFI = 手術室（最嚴格的無菌管控）
blocks.en: WFI = the operating room (the strictest aseptic control)

blocks.zh: WFI 必須將內毒素（Endotoxin）控制到極低水平，因為內毒素進入血液會引發致命的熱原反應。
blocks.en: WFI must keep endotoxin to an extremely low level, because endotoxin entering the bloodstream can trigger a life-threatening pyrogenic reaction.

blocks.zh: 本章四大技術
blocks.en: The Four Technologies in This Chapter

blocks.zh: 本章涵蓋四種 WFI 最終處理技術，可分為兩大類：
blocks.en: This chapter covers four final treatment technologies for WFI, which fall into two groups:

blocks.zh: 蒸餾類：SE（單效）、ME（多效）、VC（蒸汽壓縮）
blocks.en: Distillation: SE (single effect), ME (multi-effect), VC (vapor compression)

blocks.zh: 膜處理類：RO（逆滲透）
blocks.en: Membrane: RO (reverse osmosis)

blocks.zh: 蒸餾是傳統的「金標準」，RO 則是近年逐漸被接受的替代方案。
blocks.en: Distillation is the traditional "gold standard"; RO is an alternative that has gradually gained acceptance in recent years.

blocks.zh: 法規要求解析
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements Explained

blocks.zh: USP vs. EP vs. JP 法規差異（出版時）
blocks.en: USP vs. EP vs. JP: Regulatory Differences (at Time of Publication)

blocks.zh: 重要法規更新（2017 年 EP 修訂）
blocks.en: Important Regulatory Update (2017 EP Revision)

blocks.zh: 本指引出版於 2001 年，當時 EP 僅允許蒸餾製備 WFI。2017 年 4 月，EP 正式修訂，也接受「蒸餾以外的等效純化方法」（包括 RO）來生產 WFI。
blocks.en: This guide was published in 2001, when the EP allowed WFI to be produced by distillation only. In April 2017 the EP was formally revised to also accept "purification methods equivalent to distillation" (including RO) for producing WFI.

blocks.zh: 這是製藥水系統領域的里程碑事件，意味著全球三大藥典現在都接受膜技術作為 WFI 生產方式。
blocks.en: This was a milestone for pharmaceutical water systems: it means all three major pharmacopoeias now accept membrane technology as a means of producing WFI.

blocks.zh: 「最終步驟」的含義
blocks.en: What "Final Step" Means

blocks.zh: USP 強調蒸餾或 RO 必須是最終步驟（final step）。這意味著：
blocks.en: The USP stresses that distillation or RO must be the final step. This means:

blocks.zh: 你可以在蒸餾前使用 RO 做前處理
blocks.en: You may use RO as pretreatment before distillation

blocks.zh: 你可以在 RO 前使用 DI 做前處理
blocks.en: You may use DI as pretreatment before RO

blocks.zh: 但蒸餾或 RO 之後，不能再加其他處理步驟（否則該步驟就變成了「最終步驟」）
blocks.en: But after distillation or RO, no further treatment step may be added (otherwise that step would become the "final step")

blocks.zh: CFR 兩項硬性規定
blocks.en: Two Hard Requirements in the CFR

blocks.zh: 雖然法規對設計細節很少規定，但有兩項明確要求必須遵守：
blocks.en: Although the regulations say little about design details, two explicit requirements must be met:

blocks.zh: 熱交換器壓差監控 — 防止冷卻水側滲入純水側（除雙管板型外）
blocks.en: Pressure differential monitoring of heat exchangers — to prevent the cooling water side from leaking into the pure water side (except for double tube sheet types)

blocks.zh: 儲罐通氣過濾 — 防止微生物從空氣進入儲水系統
blocks.en: Vent filters on storage tanks — to prevent microorganisms from entering the storage system from the air

blocks.zh: 這兩條看似簡單，卻是查廠時的高頻檢查點。
blocks.en: These two look simple, yet they are frequent inspection focus points.

blocks.zh: 蒸餾原理解析
blocks.en: Distillation Principles Explained

blocks.zh: 蒸餾純化的三步驟
blocks.en: The Three Steps of Purification by Distillation

blocks.zh: 蒸發（Evaporation） — 水加熱變成蒸汽，固體雜質與大分子留在液相
blocks.en: Evaporation — water is heated into steam, leaving solid impurities and large molecules in the liquid phase

blocks.zh: 分離（Separation） — 蒸汽通過分離器（Separator），去除被夾帶的水霧與內毒素
blocks.en: Separation — the steam passes through a separator, which removes entrained water droplets and endotoxin

blocks.zh: 冷凝（Condensation） — 純淨蒸汽冷凝回液態，即為 WFI
blocks.en: Condensation — the pure steam condenses back to liquid, which is the WFI

blocks.zh: 關鍵：蒸餾能達到 3 log（99.99%）以上的內毒素去除率，這是蒸餾在 WFI 領域長期被視為金標準的核心原因。
blocks.en: Key point: distillation achieves endotoxin removal of more than 3 log (99.99%), which is the core reason distillation has long been regarded as the gold standard for WFI.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蒸餾 = 燒開水的升級版
blocks.en: Analogy: Distillation = Boiling Water, Upgraded

blocks.zh: 家裡燒開水只是殺菌，但蒸餾更像是「只取蒸汽再冷凝」。想像一個鍋蓋上有收集裝置：
blocks.en: Boiling water at home only kills germs, whereas distillation is more like "taking only the steam and condensing it". Imagine a pot lid fitted with a collection device:

blocks.zh: 鍋裡的水含有鹽、內毒素等雜質
blocks.en: The water in the pot contains impurities such as salts and endotoxin

blocks.zh: 蒸汽上升時，雜質留在鍋底
blocks.en: As steam rises, the impurities stay at the bottom of the pot

blocks.zh: 但有些微小水滴會被蒸汽「帶走」（entrainment） — 這就需要分離器來攔截
blocks.en: But some tiny water droplets are carried away by the steam (entrainment) — this is why a separator is needed to intercept them

blocks.zh: SE vs. ME vs. VC 快速區分
blocks.en: Telling SE, ME and VC Apart Quickly

blocks.zh: SE（單效）：最簡單，一次蒸發＋冷凝，能耗最高
blocks.en: SE (single effect): the simplest; one evaporation and one condensation; the highest energy consumption

blocks.zh: ME（多效）：多段串聯，每段的蒸汽為下一段加熱，大幅節省蒸汽
blocks.en: ME (multi-effect): several stages in series, with the steam from each stage heating the next, which greatly saves steam

blocks.zh: VC（蒸汽壓縮）：用壓縮機提升蒸汽能量再循環，只需電力，不需外部蒸汽
blocks.en: VC (vapor compression): a compressor raises the energy of the steam and recycles it; only electricity is needed, with no external steam

blocks.zh: 三者產出的水質基本相同（都只蒸餾一次），差異在於能效和成本結構。
blocks.en: The water quality from all three is essentially the same (each distills only once); the difference lies in energy efficiency and cost structure.

blocks.zh: 蒸餾系統的風險點
blocks.en: Risk Points of Distillation Systems

blocks.zh: Carry over（夾帶） — 蒸汽帶走雜質水滴 → 需 mist eliminator
blocks.en: Carry over (entrainment) — steam carries impurity-bearing droplets away → a mist eliminator is needed

blocks.zh: Flooding（溢流） — 液位過高 → 需高液位警報
blocks.en: Flooding — excessive liquid level → a high-level alarm is needed

blocks.zh: Stagnant water（死水） — 未排盡的水滋生微生物 → 需良好排水設計
blocks.en: Stagnant water — water that is not fully drained breeds microorganisms → good drainability in the design is needed

blocks.zh: Seal failure（密封洩漏） — 泵浦或壓縮機密封 → 需衛生級設計
blocks.en: Seal failure — pump or compressor seals → hygienic design is needed

blocks.zh: 產能與應用場景
blocks.en: Capacity and Application Scenarios

blocks.zh: 選型邏輯
blocks.en: Selection Logic

blocks.zh: 小量需求（<100 GPH） — SE 足矣，設備簡單、佔地小
blocks.en: Small demand (<100 GPH) — SE is sufficient; simple equipment and small footprint

blocks.zh: 中量需求（25-3,000 GPH） — ME 最常見，能效比 SE 好數倍
blocks.en: Medium demand (25-3,000 GPH) — ME is the most common, with an energy efficiency several times better than SE

blocks.zh: 大量需求（100-6,000 GPH） — VC 有最大產能範圍，且可產出常溫水
blocks.en: Large demand (100-6,000 GPH) — VC has the widest capacity range and can also produce ambient-temperature water

blocks.zh: 溫度選項的意義
blocks.en: What the Temperature Options Mean

blocks.zh: WFI 的出水溫度直接影響下游儲存與分配系統設計：
blocks.en: The WFI outlet temperature directly affects the design of the downstream storage and distribution system:

blocks.zh: 80-100°C（熱水） — 可直接進入熱循環儲存系統，天然抑菌
blocks.en: 80-100°C (hot) — can go straight into a hot circulating storage system, which is naturally bacteriostatic

blocks.zh: 常溫（Ambient） — 僅 VC 提供此選項，需額外微生物控制措施
blocks.en: Ambient — offered only by VC; additional microbial control measures are required

blocks.zh: 37°C — ME 可做到，但需注意此溫度區間微生物風險較高
blocks.en: 37°C — achievable with ME, but note that this temperature range carries a higher microbial risk

blocks.zh: GPH 單位換算
blocks.en: GPH Unit Conversion

blocks.zh: GPH = Gallons Per Hour（加侖/小時）
blocks.en: GPH = Gallons Per Hour

blocks.zh: 例：ME 最大 3,000 GPH ≈ 11,355 L/h ≈ 11.4 m³/h
blocks.en: Example: ME maximum 3,000 GPH ≈ 11,355 L/h ≈ 11.4 m³/h

blocks.zh: VC 最大 6,000 GPH ≈ 22,710 L/h ≈ 22.7 m³/h
blocks.en: VC maximum 6,000 GPH ≈ 22,710 L/h ≈ 22.7 m³/h

blocks.zh: 單效蒸餾解析
blocks.en: Single Effect Distillation Explained

blocks.zh: SE 系統特點
blocks.en: Characteristics of SE Systems

blocks.zh: 結構最簡單：蒸發器 + 分離器 + 冷凝器，三件套
blocks.en: Simplest construction: evaporator + separator + condenser, a three-piece set

blocks.zh: 常壓操作（100°C），容器不需 ASME 壓力容器認證
blocks.en: Atmospheric-pressure operation (100°C); the vessels do not need ASME pressure vessel certification

blocks.zh: 冷卻水消耗大：每產出 1 加侖 WFI 需要 8-10 加侖冷卻水
blocks.en: High cooling water consumption: every gallon of WFI produced needs 8-10 gallons of cooling water

blocks.zh: 出水無壓力：需要轉送泵浦或利用位差（蒸餾器高於儲罐）
blocks.en: No outlet pressure: a transfer pump is needed, or use of elevation difference (still located above the tank)

blocks.zh: 比喻：SE 像微型蒸餾壺
blocks.en: Analogy: SE Is Like a Miniature Still

blocks.zh: SE 蒸餾器就像實驗室的蒸餾燒瓶放大版 — 一次蒸發、一次冷凝、產出純水。簡單有效，但能耗高、產量小，適合 R&D 或小型製劑廠。
blocks.en: An SE still is like a scaled-up laboratory distillation flask — one evaporation, one condensation, pure water out. Simple and effective, but high in energy use and low in output, so it suits R&D or small formulation plants.

blocks.zh: 冷卻水消耗計算
blocks.en: Calculating Cooling Water Consumption

blocks.zh: 以 SE 產出 50 GPH WFI 為例：
blocks.en: Take an SE producing 50 GPH of WFI as an example:

blocks.zh: 冷卻水需求 = 50 × 8~10 = 400~500 GPH
blocks.en: Cooling water demand = 50 × 8~10 = 400~500 GPH

blocks.zh: 這意味著冷卻水成本是 SE 運行的主要費用之一。
blocks.en: This means cooling water cost is one of the main running costs of an SE.

blocks.zh: 多效蒸餾解析
blocks.en: Multi-Effect Distillation Explained

blocks.zh: ME 核心原理：能量重複利用
blocks.en: Core Principle of ME: Reusing Energy

blocks.zh: ME 系統的精髓在於「級聯熱回收」：
blocks.en: The essence of an ME system is "cascaded heat recovery":

blocks.zh: 第 1 效（Effect）使用外部蒸汽加熱進水
blocks.en: Effect 1 uses external steam to heat the feed water

blocks.zh: 第 1 效產出的純蒸汽成為第 2 效的加熱源
blocks.en: The pure steam produced by effect 1 becomes the heating source for effect 2

blocks.zh: 第 2 效的蒸汽再為第 3 效加熱…以此類推
blocks.en: The steam from effect 2 in turn heats effect 3, and so on

blocks.zh: 只有最後一效的蒸汽需要外部冷卻水冷凝
blocks.en: Only the steam from the last effect needs external cooling water to condense it

blocks.zh: 效數越多 → 蒸汽消耗越少 → 但設備成本越高。典型選擇 3-8 效。
blocks.en: More effects → less steam consumption → but higher equipment cost. A typical choice is 3-8 effects.

blocks.zh: 效數與蒸汽經濟性
blocks.en: Number of Effects and Steam Economy

blocks.zh: 近似關係：蒸汽經濟比 ≈ 效數 × 0.8~0.9
blocks.en: Approximate relationship: steam economy ≈ number of effects × 0.8~0.9

blocks.zh: 例：6 效蒸餾器的蒸汽經濟比約 4.8~5.4，代表每投入 1 kg 蒸汽可產出約 5 kg WFI。
blocks.en: Example: a 6-effect still has a steam economy of about 4.8~5.4, meaning each 1 kg of steam input can produce about 5 kg of WFI.

blocks.zh: 相較之下，SE 的蒸汽經濟比僅約 0.9~1.0。
blocks.en: By comparison, the steam economy of an SE is only about 0.9~1.0.

blocks.zh: 注意：ME 需要較高壓力蒸汽
blocks.en: Note: ME Needs Higher-Pressure Steam

blocks.zh: ME 需要 80-120 psig 的廠務蒸汽，遠高於 SE 的 30-60 psig。建廠前需確認鍋爐系統能否提供足夠壓力的蒸汽。
blocks.en: ME needs plant steam at 80-120 psig, far higher than the 30-60 psig for SE. Before building, confirm that the boiler system can supply steam at sufficient pressure.

blocks.zh: ME 的權衡取捨
blocks.en: Trade-offs of ME

blocks.zh: 最佳效數取決於蒸汽成本、產能需求與投資預算的綜合分析。
blocks.en: The optimal number of effects depends on a combined analysis of steam cost, capacity requirements and investment budget.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽壓縮蒸餾解析
blocks.en: Vapor Compression Distillation Explained

blocks.zh: VC 原理：潛熱回收循環
blocks.en: VC Principle: A Latent Heat Recovery Cycle

blocks.zh: VC 的核心概念是壓縮機驅動的能量循環：
blocks.en: The core concept of VC is a compressor-driven energy cycle:

blocks.zh: 進水在管束上蒸發為蒸汽
blocks.en: Feed water evaporates into steam on the tube bundle

blocks.zh: 蒸汽通過分離器後進入壓縮機
blocks.en: The steam passes through the separator and then enters the compressor

blocks.zh: 壓縮機提升蒸汽的壓力與溫度
blocks.en: The compressor raises the pressure and temperature of the steam

blocks.zh: 高能蒸汽送回蒸發器/冷凝器，在管壁另一側冷凝
blocks.en: The high-energy steam returns to the evaporator/condenser and condenses on the other side of the tube wall

blocks.zh: 冷凝時釋放的潛熱，加熱管壁另一側的水，產生更多蒸汽
blocks.en: The latent heat released on condensation heats the water on the other side of the tube wall, producing more steam

blocks.zh: 循環往復，不需要獨立冷凝器
blocks.en: The cycle repeats, with no separate condenser needed

blocks.zh: 比喻：VC 像熱泵（冷暖空調）
blocks.en: Analogy: VC Is Like a Heat Pump (Air Conditioner)

blocks.zh: VC 蒸餾和家用冷暖空調的原理完全相同 — 都是「機械壓縮循環」：
blocks.en: VC distillation works on exactly the same principle as a household reverse-cycle air conditioner — both are "mechanical compression cycles":

blocks.zh: 空調壓縮機壓縮冷媒 → VC 壓縮機壓縮水蒸汽
blocks.en: The air conditioner compressor compresses refrigerant → the VC compressor compresses water vapor

blocks.zh: 空調的冷凝器放熱 → VC 中高壓蒸汽冷凝放熱來加熱進水
blocks.en: The air conditioner's condenser releases heat → in VC, the high-pressure steam releases heat on condensing to heat the feed water

blocks.zh: 能量不斷循環利用，只需投入壓縮機的電力
blocks.en: Energy is recycled continuously, with only the compressor's electricity as input

blocks.zh: 因此 VC 的主要能源成本是電力，而非蒸汽。
blocks.en: Therefore the main energy cost of VC is electricity, not steam.

blocks.zh: VC 獨特優勢
blocks.en: Unique Advantages of VC

blocks.zh: 不需獨立冷凝器 — 潛熱完全回收
blocks.en: No separate condenser needed — latent heat is fully recovered

blocks.zh: 不需外部蒸汽（常溫出水模式）— 只靠電力
blocks.en: No external steam needed (ambient-temperature outlet mode) — electricity only

blocks.zh: 可產出常溫 WFI — SE 和 ME 都只能產出熱水
blocks.en: Can produce ambient-temperature WFI — SE and ME can only produce hot water

blocks.zh: 最大產能範圍 — 最高 6,000 GPH
blocks.en: Widest capacity range — up to 6,000 GPH

blocks.zh: VC 的挑戰
blocks.en: Challenges of VC

blocks.zh: 壓縮機是 VC 系統最關鍵也最脆弱的元件。壓縮機密封設計、振動管理、以及與製藥衛生要求的兼容性，是 VC 系統設計的重點關注項。
blocks.en: The compressor is the most critical and most vulnerable component of a VC system. Compressor seal design, vibration management and compatibility with pharmaceutical hygiene requirements are the key concerns in VC system design.

blocks.zh: 前處理與經濟分析
blocks.en: Pretreatment and Economic Analysis

blocks.zh: 氯的危害 — 不可忽視
blocks.en: The Danger of Chlorine — Not to Be Ignored

blocks.zh: 所有蒸餾器的不鏽鋼材質都會被氯腐蝕。進水中的氯必須徹底去除，常用方法：
blocks.en: The stainless steel of every still is corroded by chlorine. Chlorine in the feed water must be thoroughly removed; common methods are:

blocks.zh: 活性碳過濾器（Activated Carbon）— 最常見
blocks.en: Activated carbon filter — the most common

blocks.zh: 亞硫酸氫鈉注入（Sodium Bisulfite）— 化學還原法
blocks.en: Sodium bisulfite injection — a chemical reduction method

blocks.zh: 查廠重點：確認除氯設備的維護紀錄與碳床更換週期。
blocks.en: Inspection focus: confirm the maintenance records of the dechlorination equipment and the carbon bed replacement interval.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的工廠有充足的高壓蒸汽（120 psig），但電費昂貴。WFI 需求量約 1,500 GPH，需要 80°C 以上熱水儲存。你會選擇哪種蒸餾器？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your plant has ample high-pressure steam (120 psig) but expensive electricity. WFI demand is about 1,500 GPH, and hot storage at 80°C or above is required. Which type of still would you choose, and why?

blocks.zh: 提示：考慮蒸汽供應、電力成本、出水溫度、以及產能範圍。
blocks.en: Hint: consider steam supply, electricity cost, outlet temperature and capacity range.

blocks.zh: 前處理需求對照表
blocks.en: Pretreatment Requirements Comparison Table

blocks.zh: ME 對進水水質要求最高，因為高溫高壓下結垢風險更大。
blocks.en: ME has the most demanding feed water quality requirements, because the risk of scaling is greater at high temperature and pressure.

blocks.zh: 材質與表面處理
blocks.en: Materials and Surface Finish

blocks.zh: 材質選擇原則
blocks.en: Principles of Material Selection

blocks.zh: SE：可用錫鍍銅（Tin-coated copper），成本最低
blocks.en: SE: tin-coated copper can be used, at the lowest cost

blocks.zh: ME：全面採用 316/316L 不鏽鋼，管材可選鈦合金（耐腐蝕）
blocks.en: ME: 316/316L stainless steel throughout; titanium (corrosion resistant) is an option for the tubing

blocks.zh: VC：外殼 304 SS，接液部位 316 SS，壓縮機用 316 SS 或 Inconel（鎳基合金，耐高溫高壓）
blocks.en: VC: 304 SS shell, 316 SS for wetted parts, and 316 SS or Inconel (a nickel-based alloy resistant to high temperature and pressure) for the compressor

blocks.zh: 骨架/底座：三者均可用碳鋼（不接觸純水）
blocks.en: Frame/skid: carbon steel is acceptable for all three (no contact with pure water)

blocks.zh: 重大成本啟示：MP 佔成本 25-30%
blocks.en: Major Cost Insight: MP Accounts for 25-30% of Cost

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：在蒸餾系統中，機械拋光（MP）不是微生物控制的必要條件，因為系統在高溫下運行。
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly that in distillation systems, mechanical polishing (MP) is not a necessary condition for microbial control, because the system operates at high temperature.

blocks.zh: 過度指定 MP 可能佔設備成本的 25-30%，卻不會提升水質。這是典型的「過度設計」（Over-specification）案例，是 Good Engineering Practice 強調需要避免的。
blocks.en: Over-specifying MP can account for 25-30% of equipment cost without improving water quality. This is a classic case of over-specification, which Good Engineering Practice stresses should be avoided.

blocks.zh: 比喻：鍍金門把手
blocks.en: Analogy: Gold-Plated Door Handles

blocks.zh: 在一個 100°C 運行的蒸餾系統上做精密拋光，就像在消防站門口裝鍍金門把手 — 看起來高級，但對功能（滅火）毫無幫助。高溫本身就是最好的微生物控制手段。
blocks.en: Applying precision polishing to a distillation system running at 100°C is like fitting gold-plated door handles on a fire station — it looks upmarket but does nothing for the function (putting out fires). The high temperature itself is the best means of microbial control.

blocks.zh: 表面處理的正確用途
blocks.en: The Proper Use of Surface Treatments

blocks.zh: MP（機械拋光） — 用於平滑焊接接縫，僅此而已
blocks.en: MP (mechanical polishing) — used to smooth weld seams, and nothing more

blocks.zh: EP（電拋光）+ 鈍化 — 用於所有不鏽鋼表面，建立氧化鉻保護層以防腐蝕（不是防微生物）
blocks.en: EP (electropolishing) + passivation — used on all stainless steel surfaces to build a protective chromium oxide layer for corrosion protection (not microbial protection)

blocks.zh: 非不鏽鋼合金（錫鍍銅、鈦、Inconel）— 不需要也不適用 MP/EP
blocks.en: Non-stainless alloys (tin-coated copper, titanium, Inconel) — neither need nor suit MP/EP

blocks.zh: 儀表校正要求
blocks.en: Instrument Calibration Requirements

blocks.zh: 關鍵操作參數的儀表必須使用 NIST 可追溯設備進行校正。這確保了量測數據的準確性和法規合規性。在台灣，對應的標準追溯體系為國家度量衡標準實驗室（NML）。
blocks.en: Instruments for critical operating parameters must be calibrated with NIST-traceable equipment. This ensures the accuracy of measurement data and regulatory compliance. In Taiwan, the corresponding traceability system is the National Measurement Laboratory (NML).

blocks.zh: 蒸餾系統比較重點
blocks.en: Key Points of Distillation System Comparison

blocks.zh: 三大差異化特徵
blocks.en: Three Differentiating Features

blocks.zh: VC 不需冷凝器也不需冷卻水 — 因為潛熱完全內部回收
blocks.en: VC needs neither a condenser nor cooling water — because latent heat is fully recovered internally

blocks.zh: 只有 ME 需要 ASME 壓力容器認證 — 因為在高壓（100-120 psig）下運行
blocks.en: Only ME needs ASME pressure vessel certification — because it operates at high pressure (100-120 psig)

blocks.zh: ME 可兼產 Clean Steam — 這是 ME 的額外價值（VC 無此功能）
blocks.en: ME can co-produce Clean Steam — an added value of ME (VC has no such function)

blocks.zh: Clean Steam 附加價值
blocks.en: The Added Value of Clean Steam

blocks.zh: ME 蒸餾器不僅能產出 WFI，還能同時產出純蒸汽（Clean Steam）用於 SIP（在線滅菌）。這使得 ME 在需要同時供應 WFI 和 Clean Steam 的無菌充填工廠中特別有優勢。
blocks.en: An ME still can not only produce WFI but also produce pure steam (Clean Steam) at the same time for SIP (steam-in-place sterilization). This gives ME a particular advantage in aseptic filling plants that need to supply both WFI and Clean Steam.

blocks.zh: 閱讀表格的技巧
blocks.en: Tips for Reading the Table

blocks.zh: 面對多參數比較表時，建議先問自己：
blocks.en: When faced with a multi-parameter comparison table, it helps to first ask yourself:

blocks.zh: 我的廠有什麼公用設施條件？（蒸汽壓力、冷卻水、電力）
blocks.en: What utilities does my plant have? (steam pressure, cooling water, electricity)

blocks.zh: 我需要什麼附加功能？（Clean Steam、常溫出水）
blocks.en: What additional functions do I need? (Clean Steam, ambient-temperature outlet)

blocks.zh: 我願意在哪裡投入資本來換取運行節省？
blocks.en: Where am I willing to invest capital in exchange for operating savings?

blocks.zh: 然後對照表格逐行篩選，就能快速縮小選型範圍。
blocks.en: Then screen the table row by row, and the selection range narrows quickly.

blocks.zh: RO 製備 WFI 解析
blocks.en: Producing WFI by RO Explained

blocks.zh: RO 作為 WFI 生產手段
blocks.en: RO as a Means of Producing WFI

blocks.zh: RO（Reverse Osmosis，逆滲透）利用半透膜在高壓下將水與雜質分離：
blocks.en: RO (Reverse Osmosis) uses a semipermeable membrane under high pressure to separate water from impurities:

blocks.zh: Permeate（透過液） — 通過膜的純水，即產品水
blocks.en: Permeate — the pure water that passes through the membrane, i.e. the product water

blocks.zh: Reject（濃縮液） — 被膜阻擋的雜質濃縮水，排放
blocks.en: Reject (concentrate) — the concentrated water carrying the impurities blocked by the membrane, which is discharged

blocks.zh: RO 最大特點：產出常溫水。這既是優勢（低能耗），也是挑戰（沒有溫度抑菌保護）。
blocks.en: The biggest characteristic of RO: it produces ambient-temperature water. This is both an advantage (low energy consumption) and a challenge (no protection from temperature-based microbial control).

blocks.zh: RO-WFI 的核心挑戰：微生物控制
blocks.en: The Core Challenge of RO-WFI: Microbial Control

blocks.zh: 蒸餾系統在 80-100°C 下運行，天然抑制微生物。RO 在常溫下運行，必須靠其他手段控制微生物：
blocks.en: Distillation systems operate at 80-100°C, which naturally suppresses microorganisms. RO operates at ambient temperature and must control microorganisms by other means:

blocks.zh: 80°C 熱水消毒膜（Hot water sanitizable membrane）
blocks.en: Hot water sanitizable membranes (80°C)

blocks.zh: 定期化學消毒/清洗
blocks.en: Periodic chemical sanitization/cleaning

blocks.zh: 完整性測試（Integrity challenge）
blocks.en: Integrity challenge

blocks.zh: 連續監測電導度、TOC、微生物與壓差
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring of conductivity, TOC, microbial counts and differential pressure

blocks.zh: 比喻：RO vs. 蒸餾 = 冷水洗手 vs. 熱水洗手
blocks.en: Analogy: RO vs. Distillation = Washing Hands in Cold Water vs. Hot Water

blocks.zh: 蒸餾就像用熱水洗手 — 高溫本身就能殺菌。RO 就像用冷水加肥皂（膜）洗手 — 需要額外的清潔劑（消毒程序）來確保衛生，但更省能源。
blocks.en: Distillation is like washing hands in hot water — the high temperature itself kills germs. RO is like washing hands in cold water with soap (the membrane) — it needs an additional cleaning agent (the sanitization procedure) to ensure hygiene, but it saves energy.

blocks.zh: RO 前處理與經濟性
blocks.en: RO Pretreatment and Economics

blocks.zh: RO-WFI 前處理策略
blocks.en: RO-WFI Pretreatment Strategy

blocks.zh: RO 作為 WFI 最終步驟時，前處理鏈需要比一般 PW 系統更嚴格：
blocks.en: When RO is the final step for WFI, the pretreatment train must be stricter than for an ordinary PW system:

blocks.zh: 粗過濾 — 保護膜不受顆粒損壞
blocks.en: Coarse filtration — protects the membrane from particle damage

blocks.zh: 防垢處理 — 防止鈣鎂結垢
blocks.en: Antiscalant treatment — prevents calcium and magnesium scaling

blocks.zh: 除氯 — 保護聚醯胺/TFC 膜
blocks.en: Dechlorination — protects the polyamide/TFC membrane

blocks.zh: 微生物控制 — 維持消毒劑（氯/氯胺）直到除氯點
blocks.en: Microbial control — maintain the disinfectant (chlorine/chloramine) up to the dechlorination point

blocks.zh: 死水預防 — 循環系統 + UV 殺菌
blocks.en: Prevention of stagnant water — circulating system + UV sterilization

blocks.zh: RO 的成本優勢與隱藏成本
blocks.en: Cost Advantages and Hidden Costs of RO

blocks.zh: 顯而易見的優勢：
blocks.en: Obvious advantages:

blocks.zh: 不需蒸汽 — 僅用電力驅動高壓泵浦
blocks.en: No steam needed — only electricity to drive the high-pressure pump

blocks.zh: 常溫運行 — 管線不需保溫，材質選擇更靈活
blocks.en: Ambient-temperature operation — piping needs no insulation, and material choice is more flexible

blocks.zh: 容易被忽視的成本：
blocks.en: Easily overlooked costs:

blocks.zh: 膜的更換費用（定期消耗品）
blocks.en: Membrane replacement (a periodic consumable)

blocks.zh: 清洗與消毒化學品
blocks.en: Cleaning and sanitization chemicals

blocks.zh: 濃縮水排放（水資源浪費）
blocks.en: Concentrate discharge (water wastage)

blocks.zh: 前處理系統的維護
blocks.en: Maintenance of the pretreatment system

blocks.zh: 材質選擇的 GEP 原則
blocks.en: GEP Principles for Material Selection

blocks.zh: RO 系統的一個重大成本優勢：因為常溫運行，可以使用非金屬材料（如 PVDF、PVC）。只有產品水管線需要 316L SS 或 PVDF 衛生設計。進水和廢水管線甚至可以用普通 304 SS 就行。
blocks.en: A major cost advantage of RO systems: because they run at ambient temperature, non-metallic materials (such as PVDF and PVC) can be used. Only the product water piping needs 316L SS or hygienic-design PVDF. The feed water and waste piping can even be ordinary 304 SS.

blocks.zh: 這與蒸餾系統幾乎全面使用 316L SS 形成鮮明對比，是 RO 資本成本較低的重要原因之一。
blocks.en: This contrasts sharply with distillation systems, which use 316L SS almost throughout, and is one important reason why the capital cost of RO is lower.

blocks.zh: RO 優缺點分析
blocks.en: Advantages and Disadvantages of RO

blocks.zh: 最大風險：Bacteria Grow-Through
blocks.en: The Biggest Risk: Bacteria Grow-Through

blocks.zh: 「細菌穿透」是 RO-WFI 系統最受關注的風險。與蒸餾的相變分離（100°C 蒸發）不同，RO 膜在常溫下運行，長期使用後膜的微觀結構可能讓細菌逐漸穿透。這要求：
blocks.en: "Bacterial grow-through" is the risk of greatest concern in RO-WFI systems. Unlike the phase-change separation of distillation (evaporation at 100°C), the RO membrane operates at ambient temperature, and after long-term use the microscopic structure of the membrane may allow bacteria to gradually grow through. This requires:

blocks.zh: 定期完整性測試
blocks.en: Periodic integrity testing

blocks.zh: 嚴格的消毒週期
blocks.en: Strict sanitization cycles

blocks.zh: 持續監測產品水微生物
blocks.en: Continuous monitoring of product water microbiology

blocks.zh: 思考練習：選 RO 還是蒸餾？
blocks.en: Exercise: RO or Distillation?

blocks.zh: 考慮以下場景，你會推薦 RO-WFI 還是蒸餾-WFI？
blocks.en: Consider the following scenarios. Would you recommend RO-WFI or distillation-WFI?

blocks.zh: 新建小型生物製劑工廠，預算有限，東南亞廠區，電費便宜
blocks.en: A new small biologics plant with a limited budget, in a Southeast Asian region with cheap electricity

blocks.zh: 歐洲大型充填工廠（2017 年以前），需同時供應 WFI 和 Clean Steam
blocks.en: A large European filling plant (before 2017) that needs to supply both WFI and Clean Steam

blocks.zh: 已有完善冷卻水和高壓蒸汽系統的老廠擴建
blocks.en: An expansion of an older plant that already has well-established cooling water and high-pressure steam systems

blocks.zh: 提示：考慮法規、公用設施條件、Clean Steam 需求、以及生命週期成本。
blocks.en: Hint: consider regulations, utility conditions, Clean Steam needs and life-cycle cost.

blocks.zh: WFI 系統總比較
blocks.en: Overall Comparison of WFI Systems

blocks.zh: Table 6-4 重點解讀
blocks.en: Key Takeaways from Table 6-4

blocks.zh: 資本成本：ME 和 VC 最高（H），RO 和 SE 中等（M）
blocks.en: Capital cost: ME and VC are the highest (H); RO and SE are medium (M)

blocks.zh: 能源消耗：三種蒸餾都是高（H），RO 只有中等（M）— 這是 RO 的最大優勢
blocks.en: Energy consumption: all three distillation types are high (H); RO is only medium (M) — this is RO's biggest advantage

blocks.zh: 水消耗：SE 最高（H），其餘都是中等（M）
blocks.en: Water consumption: SE is the highest (H); the rest are medium (M)

blocks.zh: 化學品消耗：只有 RO 有（用於清洗/消毒），蒸餾不需要
blocks.en: Chemical consumption: only RO has any (for cleaning/sanitization); distillation needs none

blocks.zh: 維護和外部服務：四者差異不大，都是 Low
blocks.en: Maintenance and outside services: little difference among the four; all are Low

blocks.zh: 注意事項 (4)：TOC 風險
blocks.en: Note (4): TOC Risk

blocks.zh: 如果進水 TOC > 3 ppm，RO 可能無法滿足 USP WFI 的 TOC 規格（500 ppb）。這種情況下需要額外的 TOC 去除前處理，或改用蒸餾。進水 TOC 評估是 RO-WFI 可行性評估的第一步。
blocks.en: If the feed water TOC is > 3 ppm, RO may not be able to meet the USP WFI TOC specification (500 ppb). In that case, additional TOC-removal pretreatment is needed, or distillation should be used instead. Assessing the feed water TOC is the first step in the feasibility assessment of RO-WFI.

blocks.zh: 決策矩陣思維
blocks.en: Decision Matrix Thinking

blocks.zh: 選擇 WFI 生產方式時，需要權衡以下因素：
blocks.en: When choosing a method of producing WFI, the following factors need to be weighed:

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary / 章節總結
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: WFI 是最高等級製藥用水，用於注射劑、部分眼科/吸入劑產品及注射級 API。內毒素控制是核心要求。
blocks.en: WFI is the highest grade of pharmaceutical water, used for injectables, certain ophthalmic/inhalation products and injectable-grade APIs. Endotoxin control is the core requirement.

blocks.zh: 四種最終處理技術：SE 蒸餾（小量/簡單）、ME 蒸餾（中大量/可兼產 Clean Steam）、VC 蒸餾（大量/電力驅動/可產常溫水）、RO（低成本替代方案）。
blocks.en: Four final treatment technologies: SE distillation (small volume/simple), ME distillation (medium to large volume/can co-produce Clean Steam), VC distillation (large volume/electrically driven/can produce ambient-temperature water), and RO (a low-cost alternative).

blocks.zh: 蒸餾的金標準地位：相變分離（100°C）提供天然的微生物屏障，內毒素去除 ≥ 3 log。所有藥典均接受。
blocks.en: The gold-standard status of distillation: phase-change separation (100°C) provides a natural microbial barrier, with endotoxin removal ≥ 3 log. Accepted by all pharmacopoeias.

blocks.zh: RO 的崛起：USP 允許、JP 允許、EP 於 2017 年也接受。能耗與資本成本低，但需嚴格的微生物控制與膜完整性管理。
blocks.en: The rise of RO: allowed by the USP and JP, and accepted by the EP from 2017. Energy consumption and capital cost are low, but strict microbial control and membrane integrity management are required.

blocks.zh: 前處理是系統成敗的關鍵：ME 需要最高品質的進水（TDS < 10, SiO2 < 1），所有蒸餾器都需要除氯，RO 需要防垢和微生物控制。
blocks.en: Pretreatment is the key to system success: ME needs the highest-quality feed water (TDS < 10, SiO2 < 1), all stills need dechlorination, and RO needs antiscalant and microbial control.

blocks.zh: GEP 原則貫穿全章：不要過度指定表面處理（MP 佔 25-30% 成本），材質選擇應基於功能需求而非盲目追求高規格。
blocks.en: GEP principles run through the whole chapter: do not over-specify surface finish (MP accounts for 25-30% of cost), and choose materials based on functional needs rather than blindly pursuing high specifications.

blocks.zh: 選型決策：沒有單一「最佳」方案。需綜合考量法規環境、公用設施條件、Clean Steam 需求、微生物風險管理能力與生命週期成本。
blocks.en: Selection decision: there is no single "best" option. Weigh the regulatory environment, utility conditions, Clean Steam needs, microbial risk management capability and life-cycle cost together.
